name: Shioyama Hiroto
source:
The protagonist's university buddy who's in the same major program as he is.

He's a very social person, and he and the protagonist often joke and laugh around about dumb things.

He is also the younger brother of Suzune. While they get along just fine, he's a bit scared of her due to her exerting her authority as the older one over him for many years.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.yuzu-soft.com/products/stella/character.html]official website[/url]]
